properties.name: ANTHONY, 2026-09-20: connector use "is going to be the primary use of reflow2 for most people" — which makes the tool surface the whole product experience, not one input among several
properties.statement:
FLO2 F30, filed by them as context rather than a defect, and relayed here because reflow2's own roadmap should hold the claim in writing rather than inferring it from flo2's requests. Anthony's words, 2026-09-20:

    "People just want to use their existing subscriptions/plans with the AI model of
     their choice and that they almost don't realize that they are using reflow2 (via
     a connector) in the background. I think that is going to be the primary use of
     reflow2 for most people."

⭐ NOTE THE SUBJECT: reflow2, not flo2. If it holds, the connector is not a secondary integration surface beside a CLI — it is the main way the engine meets people.

WHY IT REWEIGHTS WORK ALREADY FILED. flo2's own client is retired (`dec:idea-proto-becomes-the-hosted-service`), and everything that used to teach a person what a design graph IS — the three columns, the "Not said yet" panel, the composed ask, a clickable finding — lived there and is gone. Inside somebody else's chat there is no panel and no chip. What remains is TOOL NAMES, TOOL DESCRIPTIONS AND TOOL RESULTS. So a tool surface that is merely correct satisfies the architecture and still fails. Three things already on the record stop being polish:
· F24 — serving the type-discrimination rules as DATA. flo2 no longer owns a system prompt to encode them in, so there is nowhere else for them to live.
· F26/F28 — the reply shape, and outcome-shaped tools rather than a 1:1 mirror of the engine. The vocabulary is the interface now, so its shape is the product's shape.
· Anything that makes a tool result self-explaining: in a host chat a result that needs context the caller does not have is a dead end, because flo2 cannot render a hint beside it.

⚠️ ONE MEASURED OBSTACLE, filed in flo2's graph and worth knowing here: ChatGPT gates full MCP WRITE access behind a "Developer Mode" toggle it describes as powerful but dangerous and intended for developers. So for writes, the invisible-and-seamless story holds on Claude and Grok and NOT on all three today.

NOT A DEFECT AND NOTHING TO ACTION DIRECTLY. Recorded so the earlier items are read as load-bearing, and so a later reader meets the claim rather than reconstructing it. It is a FORECAST about usage, stated by the owner — it is his to revise, and nothing here has measured it.
